# Edit talking-head footage with Claude Code: cut dead air, add captions

**Raw takes become a reviewed edit list, a clean cut between words, then captions, B-roll and sound checked by numbers and frames.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_1c5ac9627ddb.webp" alt="A talking-head take edited in code: a woman at a podcast desk speaks with word-by-word captions that highlight the active word, then the shot punches in at the sentence break." width="480"></p>

Edit real footage with an agent: turn raw takes of a talking head, podcast, vlog, course or ad into a clean cut, then add captions, B-roll, motion graphics and sound with HyperFrames or Remotion. Reads the take as text and audio, removes dead air, retakes and stumbles without clipping words, writes the cut as an edit list a person can review, keeps every graphic on the spoken word, and checks the result with numbers and frames before a person watches; tested scripts and defaults from 2,318 editors' posts. Use for "edit this video", "cut my footage", "remove the pauses", "cut the dead air", "clean up my talking head", "rough cut", "edit with HyperFrames", "edit with Remotion", "make it look edited", when an agent's edit keeps coming back wrong, or to rank cuts with an unbiased LLM judge ("which edit is better"). Not for generating video from a prompt (varg-ai), for choosing a hosted editing service (varg-video-editing), or for finding music, B-roll or sound effects (video-asset-sources).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill edit-footage-with-code                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills edit-footage-with-code --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Clean cut MP4, edit list and FCPXML |
| Needs | nothing paid: runs locally |
| Uses | FFmpeg, Python, HyperFrames, Remotion, Whisper |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.2) |

## Ask your agent

- "Cut the pauses and retakes out of take.mp4, 12 minutes of me talking to camera, without clipping words"
- "Rough cut this podcast episode, show me the edit list first, then add captions in HyperFrames"
- "Compare cut_a.mp4 and cut_b.mp4 and tell me which edit is better and why"
